messages.subject: Yeti workshop and survey
parts:
Anyone at Columbia interested?

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: "Benjamin Reddy" <bmr...@columbia.edu>
Date: Apr 24, 2015 12:10 PM
Subject: Fwd: Yeti workshop and survey
To: "Daniel Lee" <bea...@alum.mit.edu>, <ca...@alias-i.com>
Cc:

Hey guys,

I'm not sure if you or anyone else in the Stan group would be interested in this, but if so would you mind passing it along? Thanks.

Ben

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Benjamin Reddy <bmr...@columbia.edu>
Date: Fri, Apr 24, 2015 at 9:48 AM
Subject: Yeti workshop and survey
To: p...@stat.columbia.edu
Cc: Yuanjun Gao <yg2...@columbia.edu>, Tian Zheng <tzh...@stat.columbia.edu>


Hi everyone,

We'd like to schedule a workshop on using Yeti with Rob Lane, the Manager of Research Computing. He has offered to spend an hour or so teaching us about how Yeti and the Torque scheduler work, and to give advice on best practices. Afterwards, we'll have a roundtable discussion about how people in the Stats Department are using Yeti, and how we might improve the efficiency of our programs. We'll combine all of this into a reference guide for Stats users.

Please fill out the following survey so we can schedule the workshop. If you're unable to make it to either of the options listed, please let us know some times that would work for you. Thanks!

http://goo.gl/forms/o47Un1JV4k

Ben & Yuanjun
